name: Destiny Logistics & Infra Ltd
about: Incorporated in 2011, Destiny Logistic & Infra Ltd is in the business of Transport and Construction[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
Company offers end-to-end Supply Chain management, Corporate People Movement management related professional service, and Infrastructural activities

pros: Debtor days have improved from 150 to 119 days.
cons: Stock is trading at 5.08 times its book value
Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Company has a low return on equity of 8.59% over last 3 years.
Earnings include an other income of Rs.2.66 Cr.
